% Regression slice derived from PGF shapes.multipart's custom fill path.
% Only the outer corners are rounded; internal split corners stay square.
\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usetikzlibrary{shapes.multipart}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \node[
    rectangle split,
    rectangle split parts=3,
    rectangle split part fill={red!30,green!30,blue!30},
    rounded corners=10pt,
    draw,
    minimum width=2.8cm,
    inner sep=3pt
  ] at (0,0) {Header\nodepart{two}Payload\nodepart{three}Checksum};

  \node[
    rectangle split,
    rectangle split horizontal,
    rectangle split parts=3,
    rectangle split part fill={orange!30,cyan!30,violet!30},
    rounded corners=10pt,
    draw,
    inner sep=3pt
  ] at (5,0) {left\nodepart{two}middle\nodepart{three}right};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
